post_text:
Vincent Billiard joins @LVMH Hotel Management as Chief Operating Officer and a member of its executive committee, from 5 October.

He will lead operations at @Cheval Blanc. That covers the general managers of each Maison and the operations, quality, revenue, distribution and sales teams.

He arrives from Rosewood, where he had been regional vice president since January 2024 while running @Hôtel de Crillon, A Rosewood Hotel. Earlier roles include Bulgari Hotels & Resorts, The Ritz-Carlton and The St. Regis.

The signal: LVMH is hiring from the very top of Parisian palace management as Cheval Blanc grows. Crillon to Cheval Blanc is a move between two of the city's most watched addresses.

Congratulations, Vincent, on this new role.

What is the hardest part of moving from running one palace to leading a whole brand?

Read the full article: https://hospitality-signals.com/new-in-post/2026-10-07-vincent-billiard-cheval-blanc/
